## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, and `npm run build` pass.
- [ ] `npm run check:ui` passes.
- [ ] Every new interface string is in both the English and the Polish file (`npm run check:i18n`).
- [ ] A new route is either public or withheld in `public/robots.txt` (`npm run check:seo`).
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or `.env` files are committed.
